body:
## What

`scripts/tests/test_check_provider_retirement_gate.py` (324 lines, 19 tests) — the contract suite for `scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh`, the #5610 gate that blocks retiring a provider while configuration files still reference it — is run by no workflow, flake check, or just recipe.

- `.github/workflows/scripts-test.yml:34-38` names only three sibling suites from `scripts/tests/` (`test_update_nixpkgs_inputs.py`, `test_worker_preflight.py`, `test_bitwarden_load_secrets.py`); this suite is not among them.
- `git grep test_check_provider_retirement_gate` over the whole tree returns no hit outside the suite file itself: no workflow, `flake.nix`, `lib/default.nix`, or `justfile` references it.
- It has no entry in `.github/test-suite-registry.json` either (`git grep retirement` there: no hits), so the #6185 coverage contract does not even record the gap.
- The other `scripts/tests/` suites in the same directory that do run somewhere are wired by name (program-tending in `program-tending.yml:46-47`; plan_check and the `test_*workflow*.py` glob in `research-workflow.yml:35-37`) — this one's name matches no glob and no explicit step.

## Verified this run (laptop, main 26018ce4e7)

- Hand run exactly as a workflow step would: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_check_provider_retirement_gate.py'` → **19 tests, OK** (0.4s).
- The suite pins the gate's fail-closed behaviour added for #5610: unterminated block comments fail closed (c09832df94), empty provider IDs are usage errors, `disabled_providers` tombstones pass only at the top level (52c8b24c81, f86f7e5f18), the deployed runtime overlay is checked despite XDG overrides, substring provider IDs do not false-block. Every one of those fixes landed with its only regression suite exercising them nowhere automatic.
- The gate itself is live infrastructure, not dead code: `home/common/default.nix:748` documents it and `.github/scripts/check-proxy-port-fallbacks.sh:131-133` points maintainers at it as the manual pre-retirement check — so the script is expected to work when someone reaches for it during a provider retirement, which is exactly the high-stakes moment #5610 was filed from (route proxy retired while deployed config still routed through it).

## Why it matters

A gate that is only ever run by hand, whose contract suite runs nowhere, rots silently in the same way the siblings filed as #7664 (test_auto_format_workflow.py) and #7597 (test_hardware_doc_init.py) did: the next change to the gate's comment-stripping or tombstone logic can break a pinned case and nobody will know until a retirement is wrongly blocked — or wrongly allowed through.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The suite runs in an automatic venue: a named step in `scripts-test.yml` (the house pattern for this directory) or an equivalent flake/just venue, naming the file explicitly like its siblings.
- [ ] A run of that venue on a tree containing the new step is observed green with the suite's 19 tests actually executing (not a zero-discovery pass).
- [ ] The suite is registered in `.github/test-suite-registry.json` with its real venue, per the #6185 coverage contract.
